Title: Info
Text:
From 4D v16 R4, you can define the tab order during the application runtime. You have two new commands:

* FORM GET ENTRY ORDER ( object name array ; {page number} )
* FORM SET ENTRY ORDER ( object name array ; {page number} )

When you execute the FORM SET ENTRY ORDER command, you overwrite the tab order defined in the form design.

When you execute the FORM GET ENTRY ORDER command, you retrieve the current tab order that 4D uses at runtime.

Title: Example
Text:
You can choose the tabbable object order with the objet name list on the left. Then, click on the "SET" button to apply the tabbable object order; and click on the "GET" button to retrieve the current "real" tabbable object order.

Use the "TAB" key to see the actual order in the form object on the right.
